correctness.rationale: For records r_1=3, r_(m+1)=r_m+lambda(r_m-1)-1 with least prime lambda not dividing predecessor, the next larger coprime integer definition is equivalent and every prime>=3 occurs as a record. Exact primorial replication at records P_n+1 yields labelled block recurrence c_(n+1)(q)=p_(n+1)c_n(q)-s_(n+1)(q)-1[q=p_(n+1)]+1[q=p_(n+2)]; the deletion interval and primorial terminal label are both essential. Periodic indicator F_(n,q) has density c_n(q)/P_n and differs from each next-stage approximant on at most s_(n+1)(q)+2 residues per P_(n+1). The discrepancy series converges absolutely with tail <4/P_N; boundary error for arbitrary X is negligible against factorial primorial growth. Strict positivity follows from c_j(p_j)=p_j-1 and separate q=3,5 base cases; frequency mass at gaps q>p_N lies among r congruent 1 mod P_N with ambient density <=1/P_N, preventing escaped mass. Independent generation of 176865 exact record transitions through 600000 reproduced initial c_3 and the labelled recurrence at four consecutive levels n=3..6; finite checks do not prove existence of limits.
